name: cloudflare-access
title: Cloudflare Access
description: Cloudflare Zero Trust identity for Lunora — feed the Access identity into ctx.auth via a resolveIdentity adapter, in either shape Access comes in: a policy attached to the Worker (identity arrives on the execution context; the form the scaffolded file ships in) or a hostname-scoped Access application (verify the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion JWT against your team JWKS; uncomment it and the CF_ACCESS_* env vars apply). Gating the Studio on an Access group is a separate opt-in wiring (accessAdminGate), not scaffolded here.

envVars.name: CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN
envVars.description: Hostname-scoped Access application only: your Cloudflare Access team domain (e.g. 'acme' or 'acme.cloudflareaccess.com'). Unread by the worker-policy form the file ships in.

envVars.name: CF_ACCESS_AUD
envVars.description: Hostname-scoped Access application only: the AUD tag from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard. Unread by the worker-policy form the file ships in.
